stations.title: Wilf
stations.note: The tram screen in the shed.

stations.title: Visitor
stations.text: Presses the Wenlow Open-top in the list.
stations.note: Then Next tram on the panel.

captions: In the shed, Wilf wants the tram list and the big panel beside it to agree.
A visitor picks the Wenlow Open-top, and the panel keeps on about another tram.
You keep the chosen tram in one place and hand it down, in three tasks.
The list marks the Open-top and the panel tells its story, whichever was pressed.
Same two halves, now one choice. Next tram moves the list along with it.
